rows.label: qst610302_msg0001
rows.name:
Looking down on a working factory...
The view from here is the best, mo!

rows.label: qst610302_msg0002
rows.name:
I want to watch it from here for as
long as the factory is running, mo...

rows.label: qst610302_msg0003
rows.name:
But there's something special about
watching the factory when it's stopped
too, mo...

rows.label: qst610302_msg0004
rows.name:
In other words, I want to watch the
factory from here forever, mo...

rows.label: qst610302_msg0005
rows.name:
Mo-mo!! Come to think of it, I came
here on a tour, mo...

rows.label: qst610302_msg0006
rows.name:
If I came on a tour, it has to end
sometime, mo...

rows.label: qst610302_msg0007
rows.name:
Haihabaiha will quietly go rejoin
Tourer, mo...
